description: On the tabletop in front of you are a yellow lever-like piece on small wooden blocks, a threaded wooden peg with a yellow knob, and a black circular ring. The left hand moves in to steady and pick up the black ring while the right hand lifts the threaded peg and brings it over the ring, then the right hand threads the peg through and lowers the combined pieces toward the yellow lever as the left hand adjusts the small wooden blocks underneath; the right hand continues twisting and pressing to fasten the stack onto the structure while the left hand keeps the base aligned.
